title: Block Breaker
description:
The Block Breaker is a block that breaks the block in front of it. It acts as if it was using a iron pickaxe, therefore it mines at the same speed an iron pickaxe does and can't break blocks an iron pickaxe can't break. The broken block drops in the world in front of the Block Breaker like any normally mined block; nothing is collected or pushed into an inventory behind it. Applying a redstone signal to it will disable it.

If the block in front is too hard for an iron pickaxe, the Block Breaker does nothing.
